## C8 — Closing [LIVE]

> Mystery is infinitely deeper than the simply unknown or unknowable; it is the relative knowability of the Unknown and the ultimate unknowability of the Known.
>
> Epi-Logos is more wayfaring than waypoint — a capacity for arrival at understanding with no final destination to arrive at, a ladder built from the definable that climbs toward the unknowable.
>
> The grammar is not a doctrine to believe. It is an instrument — open to evolution, stable at its core. The proof of an instrument is playing it.
>
> [Return to the Surface] · [Enter the Doorway]
